topic: Visiting Urgent Care for a Sprain

script.title: URGENT CARE FOR A SPRAIN
script.story_hook: Getting a sprained ankle checked at urgent care.
script.intro_zh: 到急診室處理扭傷的腳踝。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today we're at urgent care.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，各位！今天我們來到急診室。
script.outro: That's all for today! Keep practicing and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續練習，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。
script.char_a_description: an active man in his mid thirties with a shaved head and a short beard, wearing a gray running shirt and black shorts, holding his swollen ankle with one hand
script.char_b_description: a calm nurse in her fifties with short curly gray hair and reading glasses, wearing navy blue scrubs and comfortable sneakers, gesturing to a wheelchair
script.youtube_title: 【🏥急診扭傷🦵】「只是扭傷，沒骨折」超實用看診英文🩻聽完就會問｜Urgent Care English
script.youtube_title_en: “No Break, Just a Sprain” — Visiting Urgent Care for a Sprain
script.youtube_description:

Sprained your ankle and unsure how to explain it in English? This super-realistic urgent-care chat gets you ready in one listen. Follow the patient describing the injury, getting an x-ray, ruling out a break, and learning crutches and ice — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and speak up today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏥急診看診英文｜說明受傷・照X光・學用拐杖｜聽完就會問｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
腳踝扭傷到急診，卻不知道怎麼形容？
要不要照 X 光、後續怎麼照顧，用英文要怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進急診室，跟著病人從說明受傷經過、照 X 光、確認是否骨折，到學用拐杖與冰敷，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🦵 說明受傷：例如「twisted my ankle」、「fell running on trails」。
🩻 檢查與結果：例如「let's get an x-ray」、「no break, just a sprain」。
🩼 照顧方式：例如「crutches for about one week」、「twenty minutes on, then off」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來急診看診可以這麼簡單！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I twisted my ankle and can't walk well.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈtwɪstɪd maɪ ˈæŋkəl ənd kænt wɔk wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 我扭到腳踝，走起路很痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. When did this happen exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈsɑri wɛn dɪd ðɪs ˈhæpən ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 很遺憾。這確切是什麼時候發生的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This morning, I fell running on trails.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ aɪ fɛl ˈrʌnɪŋ ɑn treɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 今天早上，我在山路跑步時摔了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let's get an x-ray to be safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ lɛts ɡɛt ən ˈɛksˌreɪ tu bi seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 好，我們照張 X 光比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that take long, I'm a bit busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðæt teɪk lɔŋ aɪm ə bɪt ˈbɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 那會花很久嗎？我有點趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About thirty minutes, the tech is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈθɜrdi ˈmɪnɪts ðə tɛk ɪz ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 大約三十分鐘，技師已備妥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alright, then I can wait that long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈraɪt ðɛn aɪ kæn weɪt ðæt lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那我可以等那麼久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's a wheelchair, save your ankle.
dialogue.zh: 這有輪椅，保護你的腳踝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, it's really swollen and painful.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這裡真的又腫又痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The scan showed no break, just a sprain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skæn ʃoʊd noʊ breɪk dʒʌst ə spreɪn/
dialogue.zh: 掃描顯示沒骨折，只是扭傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh huge relief, honestly I was scared.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ hjuːd rɪˈlif ˈɑnəstli aɪ wəz skɛrd/
dialogue.zh: 呼，真是鬆了一口氣，我嚇到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll want crutches for about one week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊl wɑnt ˈkrʌtʃɪz fɔr əˈbaʊt wʌn wik/
dialogue.zh: 你需要用拐杖大約一星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool. How do I use these things?
dialogue.phonetic: /kul haʊ du aɪ juz ðiːz θɪŋz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend the elbow, then step through, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛnd ði ˈɛlˌboʊ ðɛn stɛp θru ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 手肘彎一下，然後慢慢跨步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, ice and rest too, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt aɪs ənd rɛst tu raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 知道了，還要冰敷和休息，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twenty minutes on, then off again.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ɑn ðɛn ɔf əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 是的，冰二十分鐘，再拿開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When should I come back for a check?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ʃʊd aɪ kʌm bæk fɔr ɛ tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候該回來複診？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In ten days, or sooner if it worsens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn tɛn deɪz ɔr ˈsunər ɪf ɪt ˈwɜrsənz/
dialogue.zh: 十天後，如果更糟就早點來。
